_comment_radarr: Optional - set both radarr_url and radarr_api_key to enable --movies, or remove both lines to skip movies entirely.
_comment_reclaim: Optional - all four have defaults and only matter once something is flagged for the hold queue in the GUI. hold_days is the cooling-off period before a flagged item can be offered for removal; max_scan_age_days refuses to act on evidence older than this; max_items/max_bytes cap a single removal run and abort it entirely rather than partially applying it.
